chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Yaqoub ibn Yazeed, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When a man proposes to a woman and consummates the marriage with her before she reaches nine years of age, separation is effected between them, and she is not permissible for him ever.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries a girl under the age of nine?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes a specific legal ruling where consummation of marriage with a girl before she reaches nine years of age results in permanent prohibition (haram) between the couple. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a key precedent for determining the age of maturity (bulugh) and the validity of marital bonds, distinguishing it from cases where separation might be temporary or reversible depending on the school of thought.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the man proposes to the woman, so he sleeps with her before she reaches nine years, separation would be effected between the two of them, and she would not be Permissible for him, ever’.
